blocks.text: Multi-Unit Living in Penticton – 116 Calgary Avenue

parts.t: Searching for a low-maintenance, revenue-generating investment in the heart of Penticton? 116 Calgary Avenue offers the perfect mix of location, modern construction, and consistent rental income. Built in 2018, this purpose-built fourplex sits in Main North, one of Penticton’s most walkable neighborhoods — just minutes from shopping, transit, schools, and downtown.

With four self-contained suites (2x 2-bed/2-bath + 2x 1-bed/1-bath), this fully tenanted property provides excellent cash flow potential. Each unit features in-suite laundry, separate meters, and modern finishes — making it attractive to both renters and investors alike.
Whether you're expanding your portfolio or entering the Penticton market, this rare opportunity combines strong location fundamentals with future upside.
strong income, modern construction, and unbeatable location
, 116 Calgary Avenue is a rare multi-family find in today’s Okanagan market. Perfect for both hands-off landlords and long-term investors looking to build equity while generating reliable returns.
This neighborhood blends lifestyle and convenience. Tenants can walk to:
– coffee shop conveniently located within Safeway
– full selection of wine, beer & spirits
– iconic lakeside park, stage & green space
– public school district serving the area
BC Transit – South Okanagan‑Similkameen Transit System
The location supports high tenant retention, reducing vacancy risk while maintaining premium rental rates.
